# Town types

## In short
MyHordes has four town types: **Small** (`small`), **Distant Region** (`remote`, which is the default class), **Pandemonium** (`panda`, the hard class) and **Private Town** (`custom`) [1]. Only Distant Region and Pandemonium count for the season ranking [2, 3]. Small towns are easier, with a 12–14 map, a head start on buildings and no shaman [4]. Pandemonium needs soul points to join (200 by default in the code) and is harder: buildings get damaged at night, defence items in the bank are destroyed, construction costs more, and citizens can turn into ghouls on their own: the first one can appear when the town enters day 5 (30% chance), then 60% on day 6 and 90% from day 7, and the count restarts after each new ghoul [5, 6]. By default, private towns give no soul points and no pictos, and their door stays locked until the town is full [7].

## How it works
**How a town's rules are built**
- A town's rules are built in layers: first the default rules, then the type its config derives from (if any), then the town type's own rules. A private town's local configuration is added on top when local configuration is allowed [8].
- When a private town is created, its base type defaults to `remote`. A base of `custom` is also turned into `remote` [9].

**Default values shared by every type** (unless a type overrides them)
- Population 40 [10].
- Map size 25 to 27, with a margin of 0.25 [11].
- 20 ruins and 1 explorable ruin [12, 13].
- Well holds 90 to 180 rations [14].
- The shaman job is disabled [15].

**Who can join (soul points)**
Unless the town is "free for all" (`OptFeatureNoSpRequired`), joining checks your soul points (SP) [16]:

| Type | Who may join |
|---|---|
| Small | SP below the Remote requirement, **or** SP at or above the "small return" requirement |
| Remote | SP at or above the Remote requirement |
| Panda | SP at or above the Panda requirement |
| Custom | SP at or above the Custom requirement |

- The code defaults are 0 for Remote, Small-return and Custom, and **200 for Panda** [5].
- The unlock `f_sptkt` skips the SP check [16].

**Other join checks**
- Your account must not be restricted [16].
- Players under a language restriction can't join towns in another language. This does not apply to towns that are free from teams, event towns or `multi` towns [16].
- Whitelists apply when they are enabled [16].
- You can't join if you are already alive in another game [16].

**While the town is still filling**
- There is no nightly attack while a town is still open (filling). The attack is cancelled, and a log entry is written if the town has citizens [17].

**Ranking**
- A town's score is its bonus score plus the days survived by each citizen [18].
- Ranked town types store three ranking thresholds (top, mid, low) [1]: Remote [1, 10, 25] and Panda [1, 7, 15]. Small and Custom are not ranked (list_entities, town).
- A citizen earns soul points equal to d·(d+1)/2, where d is the number of days survived [19].

## What changes it
- **Town settings.** Every difference below is a town setting. Private towns can change many of them (see Custom below).
- **Construction difficulty.** A building that has a hard mode starts at the town's `building_difficulty` level; buildings without a hard mode start at 0 [20].
  - A level below 0 uses the **Hard** cost set.
  - A level above 0 uses the **Easy** cost set.
  - At level 2 or higher, the AP cost is multiplied by f^(level−1), where f depends on blueprint rarity: 0.65 for rarity 0–1, 0.70 for 2, 0.75 for 3, 0.85 for 4 [21].
- **Blueprint mode "improve"** (Pandemonium). A blueprint does not unlock a new building. It improves one unfinished building of level ≤ 1 that has a hard mode, setting its level to max(1, level+1). Buildings whose parent buildings are still below level 0 are skipped, as long as another candidate remains [22].
- **Strict picto distribution** (Small). Pictos are confirmed from day 8 instead of day 5 if the player has at least 100 SP. Pictos on the instant list are always confirmed right away [23].

## Town types
**Default / Distant Region (`remote`)**
- Its only rule change is a soul generation coefficient of 1.25 instead of 1.0 [24].
- It keeps the default 25–27 map. The card calls its maps "much larger than others" [2, 11].
- Anyone can join it [2]. It is ranked [1, 10, 25].

**Small (`small`)** — not ranked; the card says the average map is 13×13 [25]. All values below come from [4] unless marked otherwise.
- **Map:**
  - Size 12–14.
  - 7 ruins and 0 explorable ruins.
  - The minimum distance of the free spawn zones is 3.
  - The wind distance is −1.
  - Blueprint boxes and firework items are placed 3–90 km from town (4–90 km for `bplan_box_e`). The default is 6–15 km (9–21 km for `bplan_box_e`).
- **Buildings:**
  - Built from the start: Workshop, Portal Lock (`small_door_closed_#00`), Watchtower (`item_tagger_#00`) and Defensive Wall.
  - The Searchtower (`small_gather_#02`) is unlocked from the start.
  - Public lights (`small_novlamps_#00`) and Sanctuary (`small_spa4souls_#01`) are disabled, on top of the default disabled list.
- **Roles and features:**
  - The shaman role is disabled and shaman mode is "none".
  - Night mode is off.
- **Rules:**
  - Citizens are protected against citizen attacks.
  - Ghoul infection starts on day 15 (default 5).
  - The massive respawn threshold is 30 (default 50).
  - Sandballs never wound (chance 0, default 0.1).
- **Watchtower:** estimation offset 8 and threshold 0 (defaults 0 and 33).
- **Pictos:**
  - Strict picto distribution is on.
  - The guide and guard pictos (`r_guide_#00`, `r_guard_#00`) are added to the instant pictos.
  - The spiritual guide picto is enabled, with an SP limit of 100 and a ratio of 0.5 of the citizens.
- **Stranger:** the stranger limits are 10 citizens and 1 unfilled day. When the stranger joins, it takes all empty slots and the town closes [26].

**Pandemonium (`panda`)** — ranked [1, 7, 15]. All values below come from [6] unless marked otherwise.
- **Map and ruins:**
  - 25 ruins and 2 explorable ruins.
  - Explorable ruins can be up to 100 km from town (default 10).
  - Explorable ruins have their own blueprint lists.
  - Exploration time is 3 min 30 s (5 min 15 s with a collector), instead of 5 min (7 min 30 s).
  - The well holds 60–90 rations.
- **Buildings:**
  - Building difficulty −1, so hard-mode costs apply. Blueprint mode is "improve".
  - About 90 buildings are unlocked from the start.
  - Blueprint rarity overrides apply.
- **Night attack:**
  - Buildings take damage from the attack.
  - Defence items in the bank are destroyed (ratio 50, at most 20).
  - The red soul cap is 666 instead of 1.2.
- **Ghouls and wounds:**
  - Ghoul mode is "airborne". The infection starts on day 3 and its chance grows by 0.3 per day (default day 5 and 0.1).
  - The infection death chance is 0.75 (default 0.5).
  - The wound terror penalty is 0.2 (default 0.05).
  - Citizen attacks cost 4 AP and wound with a 0.6 chance (defaults 5 AP and 0.5).
  - Sandballs wound with a 0.85 chance.
- **Camping:** base bonus −30 and the "hard" chance table.
- **Homes:**
  - Home upgrades are hidden.
  - You can upgrade your home more than once per day [27].
- **Pictos and rewards:**
  - Last death on day 6, with the pictos `r_surlst_#00` and `r_suhard_#00`.
  - The survival picto is `r_pande_#00`.
  - The generosity factor for the last death is 2.
  - The soul generation coefficient is 1.75.
  - There is no Q&A post.
  - Heroic experience: 2 HXP for surviving at least 5 days and 5 HXP for at least 10 days in a Pandemonium town [28].

**Private Town (`custom`)** — not ranked.

Defaults [7]:
- No soul points and `give_all_pictos` turned off.
- Free from teams.
- The door stays locked until the town is full [29].
- The town is cancelled after 2 days without filling (default 7). The empty-town counter is incremented and the grace value is 40.

Limits on creation [9]:
- **For everyone:**
  - Population 10–80.
  - Map 10–35.
  - 0–30 ruins and 0–5 explorable ruins.
  - Explorable ruins: 1–5 floors and 8–25 tiles per side.
  - The well can't be negative.
- **Locked for normal players (CROW rights needed).** Anything below is dropped or reset for normal players:
  - Using a non-custom type, a custom town name, a seed, events or event tags, a schedule, or organizers.
  - Turning on soul points or `give_all_pictos` (or touching other picto options), or unlocking the door before the town is full.
  - Any open-town limit other than 2.
  - Disabling jobs or roles other than exactly `['shaman']`.
  - Choosing initial, unlocked or disabled buildings.
  - A population other than 40.
  - A map larger than 27.
  - More than 3 explorable ruins.
  - Explorable ruins with x or y other than 13. A floor or room setting also needs CROW rights; normal players are capped at 3 floors and 20 rooms.
  - A map margin other than 0.25.
  - A well above 300 rations.
  - An initial chest other than one `beta_drug_#00`.
  - Citizen aliases, free-for-all or free-from-teams options.
  - Changed exploration times.
  - A creator incarnation other than "incarnate".

## Not verified
- What the soul generation coefficient (1.25 for Remote, 1.75 for Pandemonium) actually changes: I found no code that uses it.
- The SP requirements used on live servers. I only saw the code defaults: 200 for Pandemonium, 0 for the others.
- What triggers the stranger in Small towns. I only read the rule values and what happens when it joins.
- How the ranking thresholds are used for rewards.
- Why the Remote card says its maps are "much larger": the Remote rules do not change the default map size.
- The floor and room limits (3 and 20) for private towns. Because of how the code is written, it most likely needs CROW rights for any floor or room value that is set, not only values above 3 or 20 (normal players then get 3 floors or 20 rooms).
